stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para Paulista (PE): sol, com pancadas de chuva de manhã e muitas nuvens à tarde; à noite, tempo firme

en.title: Weather forecast today for Paulista (PE): sun, with rain showers in the morning and many clouds in the afternoon; at night, clear skies
en.summary: Saturday in Paulista, PE will feature morning rain showers and afternoon clouds, with clear conditions at night. Temperatures range from 24°C to 29°C.

stories.title: Rock in Rio 2026: Stray Kids se apresenta no Palco Mundo

en.title: Rock in Rio 2026: Stray Kids performs on Palco Mundo
en.summary: The K-pop band Stray Kids is the main attraction for the second weekend of the Rock in Rio 2026 festival, which continues through the 13th.

stories.title: 'Dark Horse': produtor dos EUA de filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro diz que só entrega documentos à PF com ordem da Justiça americana

en.title: 'Dark Horse': US producer of film about Jair Bolsonaro says he will only hand over documents to Federal Police with order from American courts
en.summary: A producer of the Bolsonaro film 'Dark Horse' stated that company documents stored in the US will not be provided to Brazilian authorities without a formal legal cooperation request from American courts.

stories.title: Produtor de 'Dark Horse' diz que só entrega documentos à PF se Justiça dos EUA ordenar

en.title: Producer of 'Dark Horse' says he will only hand over documents to Federal Police if US courts order it
en.summary: Michael Brian Davis, a US partner in the production company behind the film 'Dark Horse', refused the Federal Police's request to voluntarily provide information about production expenses in the United States.

stories.title: Stray Kids: Confira provável setlist de grupo no Rock in Rio

en.title: Stray Kids: Check the probable setlist for the group at Rock in Rio
en.summary: Information about Stray Kids' expected performance schedule at the Rock in Rio music festival is provided.

stories.title: SP: Defesa Civil emite alerta severo com condição para granizo neste sábado (12)

en.title: SP: Civil Defense issues severe alert with conditions for hail this Saturday (12)
en.summary: An extratropical cyclone is causing instability across Brazil with cold and rainy weather. São Paulo's Civil Defense issued a severe alert for heavy rain, intense wind gusts, and hail conditions on Saturday.

stories.title: Defesa Civil emite alerta de chuva forte e rajadas de vento intensas para a capital paulista

en.title: Civil Defense issues alert for heavy rain and intense wind gusts for São Paulo's capital
en.summary: Civil Defense has issued a weather alert for the São Paulo capital region warning of heavy rainfall and strong wind gusts.

stories.title: Datafolha: Aliados de Lula e de Flávio Bolsonaro falam em estabilidade na eleição apesar da crise no STF

en.title: Datafolha: Allies of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro speak of stability in the election despite the crisis in the STF
en.summary: Supporters of President Lula and PL candidate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro believe a Datafolha poll has not yet fully reflected the impacts of the Supreme Court crisis and new developments in the Master case.

stories.title: Alok toca k-pop e levanta fãs do Stray Kids com set de festa de formatura no Rock in Rio

en.title: Alok plays k-pop and energizes Stray Kids fans with graduation party set at Rock in Rio
en.summary: Brazilian DJ Alok performed at Rock in Rio festival, incorporating k-pop into his electronic music set. His performance featured characteristic elements of electronic dance music including buildup, visual effects, and the signature 'drop' moment that engaged the audience.

stories.title: Produtor de Dark Horse nos EUA se recusou a fornecer informações para a PF

en.title: Producer of Dark Horse in the US refused to provide information to Brazilian Federal Police
en.summary: The American production company behind the film Dark Horse, which documents Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory, declined to hand over financial and banking documents to Brazilian authorities, keeping 72 percent of the film's production costs undisclosed.

stories.title: Defesa Civil envia alerta para chuva forte, ventania e granizo em SP

en.title: Civil Defense issues alert for heavy rain, strong winds and hail in São Paulo
en.summary: São Paulo's Civil Defense issued a weather alert warning of heavy rainfall expected across the capital in the coming hours.

stories.title: Pesquisa Datafolha mostra Lula com 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro com 44% em um possível 2º turno

en.title: Datafolha survey shows Lula with 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 44% in possible runoff
en.summary: A Datafolha poll released Friday indicates a technical tie between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical presidential runoff election.

stories.title: Governo publica MP que concede subsídio a produtores e importadores de diesel

en.title: Government publishes provisional measure granting subsidy to diesel producers and importers
en.summary: The Brazilian government issued a provisional measure authorizing subsidies for diesel producers and importers at R$ 1.00 per liter for up to 30 days.

stories.title: PF vê 'descompasso' de plano de negócios de 'Dark Horse' com parâmetros realistas

en.title: Federal Police sees 'mismatch' between 'Dark Horse' business plan and realistic parameters
en.summary: Federal Police questioned the business plan for financing the film "Dark Horse" about former president Jair Bolsonaro, arguing that projections significantly diverge from realistic parameters.

stories.title: Produtor do 'Dark Horse' nos EUA diz que não entregará documentos à PF sem ordem da Justiça americana

en.title: Producer of 'Dark Horse' in the US says he will not deliver documents to Federal Police without American court order
en.summary: A US-based producer of the film "Dark Horse" instructed that company documents held in the United States not be provided to Brazilian authorities without a request through official judicial cooperation channels.

stories.title: Após operação contra Jaques, PF pediu levantamento de visitas ao senador

en.title: After operation against Jaques, Federal Police requested survey of visits to senator
en.summary: More than a month after an operation targeting senator Jaques Wagner, Federal Police requested the Senate provide records of visits to his office by five individuals under investigation in the Banco Master case.

stories.title: Lula diz para Trump 'não meter bedelho' nas eleições

en.title: Lula tells Trump to 'not meddle' in elections
en.summary: During a campaign event in Porto Alegre, Brazil's President Lula conveyed a message to U.S. President Trump regarding potential interference in Brazilian elections, stating that Trump should not intervene in Brazil's electoral process.
